name: @fantastic-dev/convex-tinybird
description: Reusable Convex component for shipping analytics events to Tinybird, independent of any host application's schema, auth or packages.

scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run check:boundary && pnpm run check:secrets && node scripts/check-codegen-fresh.mjs && node scripts/check-readme-samples.mjs && node --test scripts/check-boundary.test.mjs scripts/check-no-secrets.test.mjs scripts/check-codegen-fresh.test.mjs scripts/check-readme-samples.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @fantastic-dev/convex-tinybird-example run typecheck && pnpm --filter @fantastic-dev/convex-tinybird-example run test
